description: Save a search for the calling agent principal. New matching listings are sent to each channel: webhook (HMAC-signed POST), email, or a pollable resource at /api/mcp/resources/subscriptions/{id}. Requires credentials.

channels.description: Where to send new matches: 1-5 of webhook (public https URL), email, or mcp_resource (poll).

query.description: Marketplace filter object (category, minPrice, maxPrice, minQuantity, search, sellerCountry, condition, moqRange, bulkDealsOnly).

name: subscribe_to_query
title: Subscribe to a saved search
